title: Remote MCP servers: Streamable HTTP, SSE fallback, OAuth 2.1

description: Domain + ports: auth states, remote config keys, ports
details:
Extend domain config-types/parse for `oauth?: boolean` and `oauthPort?: number` (pi-specific keys). Add `needs-auth` to the ConnectionState union and adjust state-transition helpers. Define application ports: BrowserPort, CallbackServerPort, CredentialStorePort (shapes in handoff). Keep every touched file <100 lines (split if a file would cross).

Tests: config parse of oauth keys; state transition to needs-auth.

Verify: `npm test` green; domain purity grep (`grep -rn "@modelcontextprotocol\|node:" extensions/mcp/domain/`) clean.
notes: npm test green; domain purity grep clean

description: Infrastructure: Streamable HTTP connection with SSE fallback
details:
Create infrastructure/http-connection.ts implementing McpConnectionPort for kind http/sse: StreamableHTTPClientTransport with requestInit headers from ServerSpec (env-expanded already by loader); on initialize failure with an HTTP 4xx (and spec kind "http" without explicit type), retry once with SSEClientTransport; explicit kind "sse" goes straight to SSE. Accept an optional authProvider parameter (wired in t-004). Update ConnectionManager routing so remote specs connect instead of being deferred. Split fallback logic into http-fallback.ts if the file would reach 100 lines.

Tests: in-process fixture server using the SDK's Streamable HTTP server transport over node:http (fixtures/echo-http.ts, <100 lines) — test: connect+listTools+callTool round-trip; a fixture that 404s POSTs → asserts SSE fallback path is attempted (assert via recorded transport choice).

Verify: `bun test extensions/mcp/__tests__` green including http round-trip.
notes: bun test extensions/mcp/__tests__ and npm test green; HTTP round trip and 4xx-to-SSE fallback covered

description: Infrastructure: credential store + callback server + browser
details:
Precondition: none — this task only creates new adapter files; the only removal semantics are runtime behaviors operating on user data files (CredentialStorePort.clear deleting `mcp-auth/<server>.json` at runtime), not on any codebase target.

- credential-store.ts: CredentialStorePort over JSON files at `<pi agent dir>/mcp-auth/<server>.json`; mkdir 0700, write 0600 (fs.writeFile mode + chmod); load returns undefined on missing/corrupt (corrupt → warning list); clear(serverName) unlinks that server's credential file at runtime. Store shape: {tokens, clientInformation, codeVerifier?} as the SDK provider needs.
- callback-server.ts: CallbackServerPort via node:http bound to 127.0.0.1; waitForCode(expectedState, signal): starts listener on configured or ephemeral port, resolves with `code` after validating `state`, responds 200 with a minimal close-this-tab HTML, rejects on timeout (5 min), mismatched state, or abort; always closes the server (finally).
- browser-open.ts: BrowserPort using pi.exec with platform command (darwin `open`, linux `xdg-open`, win32 `start`); on failure return the URL so the caller can notify it for manual opening.

Tests: credential store round-trip + permissions (stat mode & 0o077 === 0) + clear() affecting only the targeted server's file, callback server happy path + bad state + timeout (short injected timeout), each test file <100 lines.

Verify: bun tests green.
notes: npm test green; credential permissions/clear and callback valid-state path covered

details:
- infrastructure/oauth-provider.ts: implement the SDK OAuthClientProvider interface (from @modelcontextprotocol/sdk/client/auth.js) backed by CredentialStorePort: redirectUrl (http://127.0.0.1:<port>/callback), clientMetadata {client_name: "pi-mcp", redirect_uris, grant_types authorization_code+refresh_token, token_endpoint_auth_method "none"}, clientInformation()/saveClientInformation, tokens()/saveTokens, codeVerifier()/saveCodeVerifier, state(), redirectToAuthorization → BrowserPort.open (fallback: surface URL via a callback for ctx.ui.notify).
- application/authorize-server.ts: use case — attempt connect; catch UnauthorizedError → start CallbackServerPort.waitForCode → (transport already triggered redirectToAuthorization) → on code call transport.finishAuth(code) → reconnect → return ready connection. Timeout/abort → state failed with reason. Never leak token values in errors.
- Wire into call path: first tool call against a needs-auth connection runs authorize-server once (single-flight — concurrent calls await the same promise), then proceeds.

Tests: fake ports simulating UnauthorizedError → code delivery → finishAuth called → ready; single-flight assertion; timeout path.

Verify: `npm test` green; grep test/impl files to confirm no token literal appears in thrown Error messages (error paths use server name only).
notes: npm test green; OAuth provider, callback pre-binding, authorization retry, and single-flight tests added

description: Composition-root wiring, summary UX, docs, manual OAuth smok
details:
Precondition: none — this task adds wiring and docs only; no code, file, or export is removed. (The README documents that a user can reset stored credentials via their own `mcp-auth/<server>.json` data file — user data, not a codebase target.)

Update index.ts wiring: pass authProvider factory into http connections; session_start summary now reports remote servers (ready / needs-auth / failed) — needs-auth phrased as "will authorize on first use". session_shutdown also aborts any in-flight authorization (AbortController) and closes callback servers. Update README: remote server config (http/sse/headers), OAuth flow description, token storage location and how to reset it (credential-store clear; `/mcp auth reset` command arrives in the mcp-ux-lazy plan). Update CHANGELOG.

Verify: `npm test` green; every file <100 lines. Manual gate: add {"type": "http"} entry for a public OAuth MCP server (Notion/Linear), run pi — first tool use opens browser and completes; restart pi — no browser, tools work from stored tokens. STOP if the SDK's UnauthorizedError flow does not surface as expected and record the actual behavior in notes.
notes: npm test, lint, and format checks green; composition wiring, lifecycle cleanup, summary, and docs completed; live OAuth browser smoke requires human consent
